Mixed: stated part — A&P headings copied and nothing above; no A&P heading shows the 'not found' message; our part — An appended addendum and a discharge summary's instructions (Q1) (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S21 Copy Assessment & Plan only: note format × what lands on the clipboard

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 'Copy Assessment & Plan only' copies just the A&P section to the clipboard. (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Six charts with generated notes in different formats, both contexts

When Tap 'Copy Assessment & Plan only' on each and read the clipboard

Then Single 'ASSESSMENT AND PLAN' heading → that section to its end, no SUBJECTIVE/OBJECTIVE text; separate ASSESSMENT + PLAN headings → both, nothing above; appended ADDENDUM → A&P without the addendum (Q1); Discharge summary → its A&P part, no discharge instructions (Q1); SNF follow-up note N-N → ASSESSMENT + PLAN; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Clipboard text per row: mustContain the A&P sentences, mustNotContain the SUBJECTIVE/OBJECTIVE sentences and (per Q1) the addendum and discharge instructions. The button is not built on main (known: TFA-92595 AC 4), so the scenario is blocked until it exists
